text: The Patriots face the surging Raiders this week with their injury situation showing modest improvement: Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after dealing with an injury, though Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis remain sidelined, and the team has bolstered its depth by signing safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster and linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad. The 2-2 Patriots return home to Gillette Stadium to take on the 3-1 Raiders, who have been buoyed by Kirk Cousins' torrid start to the season—one of the league's biggest surprises so far—making this an intriguing matchup between a Patriots team looking to build momentum and a division rival that's emerged as an early-season threat. New England will sport throwback uniforms for the occasion as Kraft Sports + Entertainment simultaneously unveils a new 15,000-square-foot JetBlue Loft at Gillette Stadium, transforming the space into a premium hospitality destination and the new home of the Patriots Tailgate Party presented by Bud Light.
